when.en: A frontend change must also be walked by a real person's journey before it is published; a person asked for the UAT run by name.
when.vi: Một thay đổi frontend còn phải đi qua hành trình của người thật trước khi publish; có người yêu cầu đích danh lần chạy UAT.

mission.goal: a frontend change is walked by a named journey before it is published

doneWhen.evidence: the surface is committed on the session branch
the committed head is served on the product port
the served surface passes the audit with its screenshots kept
a person's journey completes on the served surface
the session branch is merged and pushed

rewrite: frontend trio → interface.generate; post-write bind → runtime.serve; frontend.surface.audit → interface.audit. Since 1.5.0 every published surface is walked, so this fixture plans the same chain as frontend-reconstruct.
